defect: The fix passes &bind_data so the written value carries the optional/presence marker that ReadProperty into a unique_ptr expects.
reason: This change only added the field id 100; the write/read mismatch arose when commit 0d5783f made pointer serialization emit OnOptionalBegin, while a direct reference write was equivalent before.

defect: The fix only changes the thrown exception type from SerializationException to InternalException in ReadData and ReadField.
reason: Switching to a more aggressive exception type for debugging is a policy change, not a repair of wrong behaviour in the added ReadField.

defect: Replacing '#if defined(_WIN32) && !defined(__MINGW32__)' by '#ifdef _WIN32' makes DUCKDB_API expand to __declspec(dllimport/dllexport) on MinGW, breaking the MinGW build.
reason: The fix restores the !defined(__MINGW32__) guard on exactly the DUCKDB_API condition this change rewrote.

defect: The fix destroys the appender that duckdb_appender_create allocates even on failure, which AppenderWrapper leaked by just nulling it.
reason: This change only moved AppenderWrapper verbatim from adbc.cpp into adbc.hpp; the identical leaking constructor existed before.

defect: GetDescription's return type was narrowed from py::object to py::list although the implementation returns py::none() when there is no result, so conversion of None to a list raises instead of returning None.
reason: The fix changes the same declaration to Optional<py::list>, repairing the type narrowing this change introduced.

defect: The fix stops null padding from appending a spurious all-NULL row when no column of a partial row was parsed (chunk_col_id == 0).
reason: The padding block already ran unconditionally with null_padding before this change, which only added the number_of_rows < STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE bound.

defect: The fix moves ctename into the member instead of copying it (clang-tidy).
reason: The copy ctename(ctename) predates this formatting-only change and is a tidy/performance item, not a defect.

defect: The fix adds a rule preferring a valid quoted row that starts earlier, flips the strict machine's rfc_4180 default, and removes redundant parentheses, to stop a spurious partitioned_write_tpch failure.
reason: The row-selection logic was rewritten by this change, but neither old nor new logic chose by start position and the failure appeared after many January 2025 rfc_4180 changes, so the origin cannot be pinned to this change.

defect: ConvertDictToSelVec dropped result_offset, so defines and filter are indexed from 0 although define_out is filled at define_out + result_offset, reading wrong defines/filter bits when a read spans several pages.
reason: The fix restores the result_offset parameter and indexing removed by this change.

defect: The fix changes the BindCopyDatabaseSchema/Data signatures to receive the resolved catalogs; the repaired defects (empty database plan, read-only marking, same-database copy) are in bind_copy_database.cpp.
reason: The header lines only declare the functions; the change to them is an interface refactor, while the defects lie in another file.

defect: TableBinding::Bind asserts D_ASSERT(entry) in debug builds although a table binding may have no catalog entry (e.g. table functions), so debug builds fail the assertion.
reason: The old code explicitly allowed a null entry (D_ASSERT(!entry || ...)), and the fix wraps the new checks in if (entry).

defect: The fix replaces the single Binder in OrderBinder with the left and right child binders so table-qualified ORDER BY names resolve in set operations.
reason: Before this change BindOrderExpression already bound table names with the set-operation binder itself, so qualified ORDER BY in UNIONs was not supported before either; the fix adds that capability.

defect: The fix records original_expressions after BindTableNames so set-operation ORDER BY can match table-qualified expressions.
reason: The unqualified copies match what GatherAliases used before (the raw select list); supporting qualified names is new functionality added by the fix.

defect: The fix changes the OrderBinder binder parameter (added later) to a list of binders and adds the column name to the error message.
reason: None of the repaired behaviour stems from this change's constructors or error message; the binder member was introduced by a later commit.

defect: The fix restructures switch statements for clang-tidy and adds an explicit include.
reason: The code compiled (optionally_owned_ptr is implicitly constructible from a reference) and behaved correctly; the fix is tidy cleanup.

defect: The fix corrects the typo 'parqet' in a test case name.
reason: A typo in a test name is not a defect.

defect: The new public ColumnData::statistics member is merged by concurrent appends and updates (and later read) without any lock, a data race.
reason: The fix makes the statistics private and guards every access with a new stats_lock, repairing the unsynchronized shared state this change introduced.

defect: The fix routes statistics merges through a locked MergeStatistics and moves the update merge into UpdateSegment::Update.
reason: The unsynchronized statistics->Merge in Update dates from 1187b35; this change only re-enabled the same line against the new UpdateSegment's statistics.

defect: DataTable::GetStatistics copies columns[column_id]->statistics without a lock while appends and updates merge into it concurrently, a data race.
reason: The fix replaces this exact line with the locked ColumnData::GetStatistics.

defect: The fix uses references instead of copies for schema/name/type in GetLookupProperties (clang-tidy).
reason: Unnecessary copies are a tidy/performance item, not a defect.

defect: The fix adds a close flag to Invalidate; the repaired invalidation logic for partial rows lives in appender.cpp.
reason: The header line only declares Invalidate; extending its signature is an interface change, not a defect in these lines.

defect: TransformVersionNumber reads Child<IdentifierParseResult>(1) although the grammar rule VersionNumber <- Identifier has a single child, so installing an extension at a version fails.
reason: The fix rewrites this exact transform (with a corrected grammar), repairing the index/type mismatch this change introduced.

defect: The fix adapts the test to the later ExtensionLoader(ExtensionActiveLoad&) constructor.
reason: ExtensionLoader(DatabaseInstance&, const string&) existed at this change; the compile failure came from a later API change.

defect: The fix removes a leftover debugging block with an unused variable (auto call_me = "sdfvs").
reason: The removed lines are dead debug code with no behavioural effect (only a warning under the optional -Werror build).

defect: The fix adds an explicit cast for an idx_t-versus-double comparison flagged by clang-tidy.
reason: The implicit conversion behaves correctly; the fix is tidy cleanup.

defect: The fix indexes the list child vector directly by child_offset instead of child_offset % STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE.
reason: With this change's ChunkCollection storage the modulo after GetChunkForRow was correct; it became wrong when list children were later stored in a single vector.

defect: Adding the cast moved a parenthesis, turning pow(2, n - 1) into pow(2, n) - 1, so the debug assertion on per-neighbor subset counts fails.
reason: The fix restores the original parenthesization in the line this change rewrote.

defect: The fix derives the data frame relation alias from the data frame pointer instead of rand().
reason: The fix ('fixing examples') makes aliases deterministic; no wrong result or crash from the rand()-based alias is shown.

defect: The fix handles a NULL-valued JSON structure argument in JSONTransformBind and reorders the includes.
reason: This change only added two includes; the NULL-structure bug is in pre-existing bind code.

defect: The fix transforms the CASE root argument once and copies it per WHEN instead of transforming it on every iteration.
reason: The per-iteration transform existed before; this change only replaced move with std::move.

defect: The generic search for the failing row was commented out and line_error is only computed for comma-separated floats, so cast errors in other paths (e.g. date format) report the line of the chunk start.
reason: The fix threads line_error through TryCastDateVector, repairing the wrong line numbers caused by this change.

defect: GetLine clears current_batches, so after one error every other erroring thread passes CanItGetLine and computes its line while earlier batches are unfinished, hitting the 'Missing batch index' InternalException or reporting inconsistent lines.
reason: The fix replaces the clear() with a done flag that returns the first error's line.

defect: LineInfo keeps no record of an error already reported, so when an earlier batch throws without finishing, a later erroring thread spins forever in CanItGetLine.
reason: The fix adds done and first_line to this struct and a line_error parameter to GetLine so later errors return immediately.

defect: The fix renames the output column 'thread' to 'thread_id'.
reason: Renaming a column to match naming used elsewhere is an interface/test alignment, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix ensures the recursive_cte flag is also set on RIGHT/FULL outer hash joins without adding a second child pipeline.
reason: The recursive_cte handling was added by a later commit (b4cb2fe); this change's else-if added one child pipeline per join correctly.

defect: ToNamedParameters emits option names 'skip_rows', 'date_format' and 'timestamp_format' that the CSV option parser does not recognize ('skip', 'dateformat', 'timestampformat').
reason: The fix renames exactly these keys in the function this change added.

defect: The fix moves the named-parameter parsing, including auto_type_candidates, from ReadCSVBind into BufferedCSVReaderOptions::FromNamedParameters.
reason: For this file the fix is a code move/refactor; the auto_type_candidates parsing is carried over, not repaired.

defect: Feeding every named parameter to SetReadOption fails for options it does not handle (columns, names, types, all_varchar, file options), raising unrecognized-option errors.
reason: The fix replaces this loop with FromNamedParameters, which handles all read_csv parameters.

defect: The fix only rejoins the ListVector::Append call onto one line (formatting).
reason: Formatting is not a defect.

defect: The fix wraps the over-long std::cout.write line to satisfy the format check (other fix hunks touch unrelated code).
reason: Line length/formatting is a style issue, not a defect.
